title: European sewage ResFinder gene counts
citation: Becsei A, Fuschi A, Otani S, et al. Nature Communications 15, 7551 (2024).
license: CC BY-NC-ND 4.0 (article notice; no separate data licence found in the checked workbook or article XML)
license_scope: Third-party source data; not covered by the application MIT licence. Exact factual counts and sample fields are extracted; source values are unchanged. No article figures or prose are included.
normalization_status: Not normalized for cross-sample abundance comparison
clinical_pairing: No clinical susceptibility pair table in this workbook
run_count_rule: Count-linked runs use the exact alias/replica key. Associated run counts include all metadata runs with the same ENA_SAMPLE_ACCESSION as a selected matrix row; their contribution to a count value is not inferred.
measurement_method: Sequence-fragment counts mapped with KMA v1.2.8 to ResFinder commit 3eedbde; related alleles grouped at 90% identity and coverage in the source analysis.
changes: Typed numeric count strings as non-negative integers; dates formatted ISO 8601; metadata joined by the reported key. No values were normalized, imputed or averaged.
